subject: Staggered credit schedule & VAT reclassification for INV-2026-07-4821
body:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@ambassador.tech
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-07-4821 - tax line and overcharge

Hi Ben,

We reviewed July's invoice (INV-2026-07-4821) and flagged two items: a service tier mischarge of $3,500 and an incorrect VAT treatment on a Europe-based reseller credit of $700 which was invoiced as VAT-inclusive when it should have been reverse-charged. Combined, this looks like a net overbilling of $4,200.

Our accounting team needs either a single credit note for the full amount or a staggered credit schedule (we can accept 2 installments into September and October), but we also need clear VAT lines so our AP system posts correctly. Can you advise next steps and provide the credit note(s) with VAT breakdown?

Thanks,
Daniel
Finance Operations
Ambassador Platform

--
Attachment: INV-2026-07-4821.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-07-4821 - tax line and overcharge

Hi Daniel — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the invoice. Apologies for the mix-up.

We can do either a single credit note or a two-part credit schedule. To confirm the numbers on our side: we see the $3,500 service tier correction (net) and the $700 VAT line that was billed incorrectly. For EU VAT, we need to confirm your tax ID/registration so we can mark the credit as reverse-charge where appropriate.

Proposed immediate actions:
- I will loop in Billing Ops (Monica) to prepare a draft credit note and a staggered XLS schedule.
- Marissa (finance) will confirm GL code and whether Redwood should return cash or issue an account credit.
- If Ambassador prefers a single credit note, we can issue it today; otherwise we'll prepare two credit notes dated Sep 1 and Oct 1.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-07-4821 - draft credit schedule attached

Hi Daniel / Ben —

I've attached a proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx that contains both options (single credit and two-installment). Quick notes from Billing Ops:
- Single credit: Credit note CN-2026-08-071 for $4,200 (Net $3,500 + VAT adjustment line $700) dated 2026-08-22. VAT line will show as 0% with reason 'reverse charge' if you supply your EU VAT number.
- Two-installment: CN-2026-09-082 (Sep 1) for $2,100 and CN-2026-10-091 (Oct 1) for $2,100. Each will include explanatory memo referencing INV-2026-07-4821.

Please confirm:
1) Your preferred schedule (single or staggered)
2) EU VAT number to populate on credit note (if applicable)
3) Whether you want the credit applied to your next invoice or refunded to the original payment method (bank transfer).

Attachment: proposed_credit_schedule.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-07-4821 - tax treatment question

Daniel — quick internal finance note copied to you: 

We need Ambassador's EU VAT registration number for reverse-charge treatment on the $700 VAT adjustment. If we don't receive it by Aug 24, we will issue the credit as VAT-inclusive and update the accounting classification, which may delay your AP posting. For GL mapping: use GL 4.21.10 for service credits and GL 2.11.05 for VAT reversals. If Ambassador requests a refund to bank, we'll need a completed wire form (I can send).

Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-2026-07-4821 - approval to proceed with goodwill credit

Looping in for a quick approval: Ben flagged this as a customer-facing friction and recommended a goodwill component to preserve renewal momentum. I approve issuing the full $4,200 as credit (no additional discount required). Monica — proceed with whichever schedule Ambassador confirms. If they want the staggered approach, we should mark memo "goodwill accommodation" on the first credit to surface in renewals reporting.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Credit notes issued: CN-2026-08-071 (draft) + DocuSign for bank refund

Daniel — appreciate the quick response this week. Per your earlier note, we issued a draft single credit note and attached the PDF here for your review. Because you indicated flexibility, we also prepared a two-installment schedule and left it in the XLS.

Summary of what we did:
- Draft credit note CN-2026-08-071 for $4,200 issued (draft). Breakout: net corrective credit $3,500 + VAT reclassification adjustment $700.
- Marked VAT line as 'reverse charge - pending VAT ID' so your AP team can flag it. If you provide your EU VAT number, we will finalize the credit as non-taxable (reverse charge) and update the credit note PDF.
- If you'd prefer two installments, reply with 'stagger' and we'll issue CN-2026-09-082 and CN-2026-10-091 instead.
- For refunds to bank, please complete the wire form at the DocuSign link and sign; otherwise we will apply the credit to your next invoice automatically.

Attachments: credit_note_draft.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123xyz

Please confirm VAT number and preferred payout approach by Aug 24 so we can finalize before month-end close.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

On Sun, Aug 22, 2026 at 14:10 Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@ambassador.tech> wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround. We will provide our EU VAT number (EU-TAX-459002) and prefer a single credit applied to next invoice. I will complete DocuSign only if a cash refund is required.
>
> —Daniel
